verdict.rationale: The docs describe fiat deposit instructions and on-chain stablecoin payment acceptance generically, but there is no evidence of per-customer named virtual accounts or dedicated deposit addresses that let a developer automatically attribute incoming funds to a specific customer for reconciliation. Fiat account/deposit-instruction endpoints ([paxos-docs-38],[paxos-docs-40]) and payment acceptance ([paxos-docs-12]) appear to be platform-level, not per-end-customer identifiers.
